title: Asker road, forty down and one along the top
medium: Walk for forty-two lime lamps on the Asker side, seen across the Long Water from the shore bench. Half an hour; the live piece runs at eight times walking pace

stages.name: The Asker side in the white hour, with the ways she is allowed walked off on it
The violet hour, before anyone is over the pass. The stage lamp is not hers
The file on the first leg, its violet still coming over the top
Hask farm: one leaves the file and has her colours to herself
The late one along the top, the one up the beck, the file between them
The same count from a boat close in under the Asker stage: the file has pulled nearly all its colours in
The same count from the top bench, 1,300 paces off: the file has no white left in it
The quay: the file standing, each with all their colours back
After the shutter. Every lamp is dark; the bench is still owed the slow colours, the far lamps most
